levels.name: Bringer of Blessing
levels.description: When the Suanni Man Chai from Suanni's Gilded Dance meets back up with Gaming, it will heal 15% of Gaming's HP.

levels.name: Plum Blossoms Underfoot
levels.description: When Gaming receives healing and this instance of healing overflows, his ATK will be increased by 20% for 5s.

levels.name: Awakening Spirit
levels.description: Increases the Level of Bestial Ascent by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Soar Across Mountains
levels.description: When Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, it will restore 2 Energy to Gaming. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.

levels.name: Evil-Daunting Roar
levels.description: Increases the Level of Suanni's Gilded Dance by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: To Tame All Beasts
levels.description: Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider CRIT Rate increased by 20% and CRIT DMG increased by 40%, and its attack radius will be increased.
